description: Use when testing authentication on an authorized engagement. Covers user enumeration, password brute force and spraying, credential stuffing with the client's own test data, session fixation, JWT attacks (none algorithm, weak secrets, key confusion), OAuth and OpenID Connect flaws, and MFA bypass techniques strictly within authorized scope on test accounts. Use when assessing login flows, session handling, token-based auth, or single sign-on integrations.
